scope_note: Oldsmobile F-85 / Cutlass / Cutlass S / Cutlass Supreme / Cutlass Salon / 4-4-2 / Hurst/Olds, 1961-1977. Vista-Cruiser and the 1977 Omega-based F-85 excluded. All Oldsmobile/GM factory literature counted as ONE source; all Wikipedia articles as ONE; Olds FAQ (Oldsmobile mail-list community reference hosted at oldsjunction.classicoldsmobile.com) as one registry source. HP gross through 1971 (1971 net in notes), SAE net from 1972. '442_only' marks engines offered in the Cutlass line only with the 4-4-2 package.
excluded: Vista-Cruiser engines (NHRA VISTA CRUISER rows), excluded per assignment.
1977 NHRA 'F-85' rows (231/105, 260/110, 305/145, 350/170): the 1977 F-85 was a trim of the compact X-body Omega, not the Cutlass; the Chevrolet 305 appears only there.
1964-1965 Jetstar 88 330 ratings (260/315 hp H.C.) belong to the full-size Olds, not the F-85/Cutlass.
